name: context-os
description: Verbatim, reversible, provenance-tracked context compaction for Claude Code (Jev or local heuristics); /context to inspect and restore.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum keep probability for a tool result or call to stay. Leave unset to use the classifier's own calibration (Jev 0.15, heuristic 0.5).

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: auto = Jev when a TypeSafe key is available, otherwise local heuristics (no network).

questionStyle.title: Jev question style
questionStyle.description: useful = "is keeping this useful" with explicit criteria (recommended); upstream = the original "must stay verbatim" wording.

archiveDir.title: Archive directory
archiveDir.description: Where evicted context is stored verbatim, relative to the project.

safetyMargin.title: Safety margin
safetyMargin.description: Results scored this far below the threshold are still kept (the classifier's uncertainty band).

sketches.title: Result sketches
sketches.description: Show the classifier a short sketch of each result instead of only its size.

redact.title: Redact secrets
redact.description: Replace API keys, tokens and passwords with placeholders before anything is sent to the classifier.

markRemovedCalls.title: Mark removed calls
markRemovedCalls.description: Append a note to an assistant message whose tool calls were archived, so later turns do not mistake narration for work still in context.

autoRetrieve.title: Automatic retrieval
autoRetrieve.description: Before each prompt, search the archive and hand the model the best exact matches as retrieved context.

retrieveBudgetChars.title: Retrieval budget (chars)
retrieveBudgetChars.description: Most characters of archived content retrieved per prompt (the host caps all hidden context at 32000).

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.
